name: Stormboyz
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 70 pts for 5 models / 140 pts for 10 models. The cost does not go up with more copies.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1 Nob model, 4-9 Stormboy models. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_loadout: The Nob is equipped with: 1 Kustom Choppa; 1 Slugga. Every Stormboy is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Slugga.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.
_wargearOptions_note: Printed as: The Nob can have their Kustom Choppa replaced with 1 Power Klaw.
